nativeScope: Immutable per-browser localStorage/sessionStorage exclusions stop backing-service control binding and navigation prebinding. Window getters, Storage Access API requests and inspector storage operations reject before accessing an excluded store. Other storage and all network remain enabled. API structural probes remain available.
privateContract: storage:true retains all storage; arrays may omit localStorage and/or sessionStorage only while explicitly including other. Configurations excluding other storage reject before launch. This is not the complete idea01 storage array contract.

expectedDependencyRejection.scope: Original shared differential explicitly uses sessionStorage; its reference leg rejects under the excluded profile. This is retained dependency rejection, not a passing shared differential or a speedup.

lifetimeCorrection.finding: Pending launch/context creation could escape original attempt teardown or enroll in a successor; context preparation errors could leave the context open.
lifetimeCorrection.correction: Enroll pending creations before asynchronous work; retain original scope and closing state, drain and retire pending creations before teardown, and close a context on preparation failure. Preserve precise DOMStorage capability identity in guarded CDP errors.

finalLifetimeCorrection.finding: The first lifetime correction deferred declaration copying, read mutable CDP parameters after dispatch, and could publish a context after its scope began closing during preparation.
finalLifetimeCorrection.correction: Copy and freeze declarations at invocation, capture storage diagnostic identity before dispatch, and recheck original ownership after asynchronous preparation.

retainedCleanupFailure.scope: The initial final-adapter Flashwright control exited with guardianCleanupFailed. Its finally block failed before report publication, so individual assertions are unverified. A later fixture preserves cleanup errors in the report; its first run and three further runs pass. No production correction or root-cause claim is made.

finalLifetimeCorrection.retainedFixtureCorrection: The initial enhanced mock fixture lacked newPage. Preserve its failed reports separately; the second fixture supplies the required context API and demonstrates all three regressions before correction.

applicationCampaign.gate: Retain every full-owner observation; all original tests and cleanup must pass before comparing. Report per-block differences against ordinary and declaration-only controls, not a complete-capability or 2x claim. Advance any candidate only if both blocks reduce full owner time at least20% versus declaration-only and neither regresses the ordinary baseline.

profiles.declared: Private declarative adapter, full native features; estimates declaration plumbing overhead.
profiles.storage: Private adapter, TodoMVC localStorage retained/sessionStorage omitted; SVGOMG both DOM stores omitted. Other storage and network remain enabled.
profiles.no-paint: Private adapter, full storage, painting/capture excluded.
profiles.combined: Private adapter, selected DOM stores and painting/capture excluded.

applicationCampaign.adapter: Pre-lifetime-correction private adapter; retain this original identity and do not attribute timings to the corrected adapter.

firstCorrectionApplications.scope: Functional refresh only; two single-worker Playwright SVGOMG runs additionally enable API diagnostic logging. Do not pool these times with the original timing campaign.

finalCorrectionApplications.scope: Final adapter functional refresh only; do not use these times for performance comparison.

denseComposition.adapter: First lifetime correction (contracts-fixed), before the final immutable-declaration and preparation-publication correction; independent two-pair synthetic composition screen.

resetTimingAttribution.interpretation: Separate ordinary-feature and combined-profile logs both show four failed stability observations on the Reset all button and explicit 20/100/100 ms retry waits. Original suite timing variation is concentrated in this test. These diagnostic runs do not establish the cause of every original fast/slow sample or make omitted service work negative.

retainedFailures.name: playwright-ordinary
retainedFailures.reason: Fixture assumed top-level Storage Access API returned a handle; this browser resolves undefined there.

retainedFailures.name: playwright-ordinary-v2
retainedFailures.reason: Child-frame Storage Access API required an explicit permission grant.

retainedFailures.name: flashwright-ordinary-v3
retainedFailures.reason: Flashwright launch.env is unsupported; native control policy moved to the original controller environment.

retainedFailures.name: flashwright-ordinary-v4
retainedFailures.reason: Ordinary Flashwright did not publish the popup page event after script window.open.

retainedFailures.name: flashwright-ordinary-v5
retainedFailures.reason: Ordinary Flashwright still did not publish the popup after trusted input; keep host popup adoption as an open gap.

limitations: Native tracing brackets fresh-context controls after browser startup and before closure; these are service-bind attempt events. Source-level early returns explain omitted binding outside that interval.
Namespace metadata and some wrapper allocations remain even when their backing service is omitted.
Uncaught page errors fail attempt health; caught/suppressed errors are not an authoritative native violation ledger.
Popups are tested natively via Playwright on this browser; ordinary Flashwright popup adoption remains a separate gap. Cross-origin tests do not independently attest renderer-process separation.
Allowed Storage Access handles are exercised with Playwright permission grants; Flashwright controls preserve expected permission rejection.
Network subsets, remaining storage exclusions, full native discovery, broader implicit painting dependencies and public test.defineFeatures delivery remain unfinished.
Wrapper environment records are not independently admitted final process policy. Sampled RSS and root-inclusive CPU are separate diagnostics, not complete cgroup resource admission.
Timing uses complete original-owner observation with the retained 100 ms watchdog polling boundary. Two blocks cannot establish population tails or broad performance leadership.
The pre-fix application matrix and corrected-adapter controls have distinct source identities. Full/sparse drawing tests are synthetic and cannot count as representative majority scenarios.
Other-platform, complete-core, packed release and majority-scenario 2x goals remain open.
